Coastal Luxury in the Heart of Seagrove – 4 Bedroom 30A Vacation Rental with Private Pool and Putting Green

Discover this newly built luxury Seagrove vacation rental—a 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom coastal retreat that sleeps 13 and offers a private gated pool with sun shelf, putting green, two living rooms, and ensuite bathrooms in every bedroom. Close to Seaside, beach access, Publix, and 30A dining and shopping, this stylish home features a fully stocked kitchen, flat-screen TVs in every room, corn hole, portable pickleball set, and six bikes for exploring 30A. Perfect for families or groups, this Seagrove Beach vacation rental blends comfort, location, and modern beachside charm for the ultimate 30A getaway.
Our prices include all fees. No hidden fees.
